$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for which model each agent runs on. The `model:` field in every .claude/agents/*.md is GENERATED from this file by validation/build-models.py and must never be hand-edited: fourteen hand-edited copies is how a swap silently half-applies. Change an assignment here, or with --set, then regenerate.

opus.use_for: Judgement under ambiguity, adversarial review, synthesis where being confidently wrong is expensive. Anything whose output a human will act on without re-deriving it.

sonnet.use_for: Structured, verifiable work with a small blast radius: mechanical checks, extraction against a schema, generation from a fixed contract. Work where an error shows up in a diff.

haiku.use_for: High-volume, low-judgement passes. NOT ASSIGNED TO ANY AGENT TODAY, and listed so a swap to it is a deliberate act with a stated reason rather than a guess.

why.opus_agents: brand-director, design-critic, handoff-scribe, orchestrator, research-ops, research-synthesizer, screen-producer. Each either makes a judgement call a human will act on, or reviews someone else's work adversarially. A confidently wrong critique steers a bad revision, and a confidently wrong synthesis becomes a requirement.
why.sonnet_agents: a11y-checker, content-comms, dashboard-analyst, diagram-cartographer, evidence-clerk, system-keeper, token-keeper. Each works against a fixed contract — a schema, a token file, a checklist — so an error surfaces mechanically rather than silently.
why.the_rule_worth_keeping: Downgrade an agent whose errors show up in a diff. Do not downgrade an agent whose errors show up as a confident sentence a human believes.

swap_safety.what_makes_a_swap_safe_here: The standing rules, the gates and the context all live outside the agent prompt, in AGENTS.md and context/context.json, so they do not change when the model does. The agent prompts are near vendor-neutral: three mentions of a specific tool across fourteen files, all naming a real toolchain rather than assuming an identity.
swap_safety.what_a_swap_does_NOT_prove: That quality held. Nothing in this repository counts clean reviews, so a downgrade that degrades judgement is invisible until someone reads the output. artifacts/*/manifest.json records the producing model on every artifact, which is the raw material for measuring that — but 8 of 36 manifests carry no model or an empty one, so the record is not yet complete enough to compare against.
